text:
Predicates:
NaziGerman(x) ::: x is a Nazi German.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Premises:
NaziGerman(heinrich) ∧ Politician(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
Member(heinrich, prussianStateParliament) ∧ Member(heinrich, naziReichstag) ::: Heeinrich Scmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ Member(x, naziReichstag)) ::: No politicans are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
